title: Sacro-Pacto
description:
A modpack and map designed for the 
Sacro-Pacto-SMP. 

~in development~
body:
Designed to expand the game in an RPG-like and nostalgic fashion with some modern mods too.

Available to use for anyone that seeks to host a server. Or play it on singleplayer!

Based on an old youtube mc series from my childhood.

Enjoy
